decisions.rationale: 2025 NOA total income of $167,895, pay stub annualization of about $164.5k and letter salary of $171,764 support the stated $164,500.
Chequing account history from April shows a $29,771 balance built from payroll with no unusual deposits, covering the $23,200 down payment with about $6.5k left for closing costs.
Panel appraiser value of $466,000 supports the price, but the appraiser recommends an engineer foundation inspection and it is unclear whether this must be cleared.
Letter on letterhead, signed by HR, shows a fixed-term contract continuously renewed since July 2021, a stable history of about five years.
GDS is about 29-30% and TDS about 34% even including the Retail Plus card omitted from the worksheet, within 39%/44%, with credit score 727.
